definitions.gloss: kitchen sink; sink unit with a counter and basin
definitions.explanation: The sink area in a kitchen, including the basin, drainboard, and surrounding counter space. In modern Japanese kitchens, this typically refers to the entire sink unit built into the counter.

examples.japanese: {流|なが}し{台|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{流|なが}し{台|だい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put the dishes in the sink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}→引っ越し先：21647_hikkoshisaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{流|なが}し{台|だい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}くて→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: The kitchen in the new place has a spacious sink area, which is easy to use.

notes:
Refers to the kitchen sink unit including the basin and surrounding counter. Composed of ⟦{流|なが}し→流し：18855_nagashi⟧ (the act of washing/rinsing) + {台|だい} (counter/stand). In everyday speech, many people shorten this to just ⟦{流|なが}し→流し：18855_nagashi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流|なが}し{台|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean the sink
- {流|なが}し{台|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排水口|はいすいこう}→排水口：16250_haisuikou⟧: the sink drain
- ⟦ステンレス→ステンレス：08832_sutenresu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流|なが}し{台|だい}: stainless steel sink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{流|なが}し→流し：18855_nagashi⟧: sink — shorter, more casual form; also used alone
- ⟦シンク→シンク：04679_shinku⟧: sink — loanword from English, common in modern kitchens
- ⟦{洗面台|せんめんだい}→洗面台：04988_senmendai⟧: washbasin — specifically the bathroom sink for face washing
